privacy.intro: Wody, Discord’u kullanmak için gereken asgari yaşın altındaki çocukları bilerek hedeflemez. Discord üzerinden erişim, Discord’un kullanıcının ülkesi veya bölgesi için belirlediği asgari yaşa ve geçerli yerel hukukun gerektirdiği daha yüksek asgari yaşlara tabidir. Geçerli hukukun, reşit olmayanların bir çevrimiçi hizmeti kullanması veya belirli bir işleme faaliyeti için ebeveyn ya da vasi onayı gerektirdiği durumlarda bu şart geçerlidir.

sections.heading: 1. Who is responsible for your data
sections.html: Wody is developed and operated by Păcurar Ancuța-Narcisa, an individual based in Romania, European Union (the “Operator”). The Operator acts as the data controller for processing activities for which Wody determines the purposes and means of processing. You can contact the Operator at privacy@wody.online. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Wody processes through the Discord bot and web dashboard, why it is processed, where it is stored, how long it is kept, and how you can exercise your rights. Where Wody processes information entered into a server by a server owner or authorised administrator, the server owner or administrator may also have responsibilities as a controller for that processing, depending on the feature and the applicable law.

sections.heading: 2. Data used when you log in with Discord
sections.html:
Wody uses Discord OAuth2 for dashboard login. After you authorize the application, Wody receives:

  • Your Discord user ID, username, global display name, discriminator and avatar identifier.
  • An OAuth access token and refresh token issued by Discord. These are stored only on the server and are used to access the Discord resources required by the dashboard.

The dashboard also requests your Discord server list from Discord when it needs to determine which servers you can manage. The server list is fetched from Discord using your access token and is not stored as part of your Wody session record.

Wody does not receive or store your Discord password. The Discord tokens and profile data are not stored in your browser cookies. Your browser receives only a random session identifier with a cryptographic signature. The corresponding session record is stored server side in the sessions collection in MongoDB. The access token and refresh token are used only from the server when the dashboard needs to access Discord resources permitted by the OAuth2 authorization.

sections.heading: 3. Data stored by the bot
sections.html:
To provide Wody’s modules and features, Wody stores information associated with Discord servers, channels, roles and members. The homepage currently presents 20 modules, including moderation, automod, welcome and goodbye messages, auto role, tickets, reaction roles, captcha verification, giveaways, levels, suggestions, auto responses, custom commands, embed building, scheduled messages, forums and logging. including Pools. Depending on the features used, the stored data includes:

  • Server configuration and settings created through Discord or the dashboard.
  • Welcome and goodbye messages, custom commands and automatic responses.
  • Moderation records such as warnings, bans, kicks and timeouts, including the Discord IDs needed to identify the affected member and moderator.
  • Level and XP information.
  • Suggestions and their moderation status.
  • Ticket information, ticket reviews and closed ticket transcripts where the ticket feature is used.
  • Giveaway entries and results.
  • Captcha verification records, such as which member verified and when, where the Captcha feature is used. To verify, a member must log in with Discord on the verification page. This login shares basic Discord account information with Wody, including the Discord user ID, username and the list of servers linked to that account, so Wody can confirm the member actually belongs to the server before granting the configured role. Wody does not receive the member’s email address or password through this process.
  • Scheduled message content and scheduling settings.
  • Forum channel automation settings, such as default tags and post cooldowns, where the forums feature is used.
  • Premium server configuration backups where the backup feature is enabled.
  • YouTube channel subscriptions and notification channel settings where the YouTube Notifications feature is enabled.
  • Your lifetime Wody vote total associated with your Discord user ID, where the voting feature is used.
  • Audit records for relevant settings changes and Premium administration, including the Discord user ID of the person who made the change where recorded.
  • Premium key and activation records needed to issue, validate, limit or revoke Premium access.
  • Pool configuration, answer options, scheduled closing times, votes and results where the Pools feature is used.
  • Image scam detection, where a server administrator turns it on: pictures attached to messages in that server are analysed automatically, in memory, by comparing image fingerprints with reference images chosen by the Wody team and, where text recognition is available, by reading the text in the picture to look for scam indicators. The picture itself is not kept by Wody. A log entry posted in the server’s own log channel may show the picture, a short excerpt of the text read from it, the links found and the details of the message. The reference images registered by the Wody team, with their fingerprints, are stored.
  • Message logs, where the Logging module is turned on: when a message is deleted, its log entry in the server’s log channel can include the message’s pictures, which Wody downloads from Discord and posts again in that channel. Wody does not keep its own copy.

Wody does not store general Discord chat history as a separate archive. Message content is stored only where a feature requires it, such as configured messages, scheduled messages or ticket transcripts. Wody does not use analytics, advertising or behavioral profiling, and the dashboard does not use third-party tracking cookies.

sections.heading: 4. Where your data is stored
sections.html: Wody stores its application and bot data in MongoDB Atlas. This includes the server configuration, feature data and server-side dashboard sessions. The dashboard application is hosted on Vercel. Authentication cookies are stored in your browser. Discord separately processes data on Discord’s own systems when you use Discord or complete the OAuth2 login process. Wody does not use analytics, advertising, behavioral profiling or third-party tracking cookies on the dashboard.

sections.heading: 5. How the dashboard session works
sections.html:
The dashboard uses a server side session. The wody_session cookie does not contain your Discord access token, refresh token or profile. It contains a random session identifier and a cryptographic signature used to detect tampering.

The session record containing your cached profile, Discord access token, refresh token and expiry time is stored in the sessions collection in MongoDB. The browser cookie can remain for up to 7 days, but the server-side session is not necessarily valid for the full 7 days. Its expiry is calculated from the Discord access token lifetime and is set 60 seconds before that token expires. When the server-side expiry is reached, the session is rejected; when that expired session is checked, its database record is removed. Logging out removes the session record and the session cookie immediately. The current implementation stores the refresh token but does not use it to refresh an expired access token.

sections.heading: 6. How we protect the data
sections.html:
Dashboard authentication cookies are HttpOnly, so normal page JavaScript cannot read them. They are marked Secure and are sent only over HTTPS. They use SameSite=Lax to reduce cross site request risks. The cookie values are cryptographically signed and a modified value is rejected. OAuth login also uses a separate short lived state value to verify that the login response corresponds to a login started by the same browser.

Access to server settings is checked against the permissions returned by Discord. A user must be the server owner or have Administrator or Manage Server permission for the server being managed.

sections.heading: 7. Why we process this data
sections.html: We process this information to authenticate dashboard users, determine which Discord servers they can manage, operate the bot features requested by server owners and members, keep dashboard changes synchronized with the bot, maintain configuration and moderation records, provide Premium functionality, prevent unauthorized access and keep the service secure and operational. Depending on the processing activity, the legal basis may be the performance of a contract or steps requested before entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR), compliance with a legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR), or the Operator’s legitimate interests in operating, securing and protecting the service (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR). Where consent is required by law for a particular processing activity, Wody will rely on consent instead.

sections.heading: 8. Who processes the data
sections.html:
Wody does not sell your personal data, use it for advertising or behavioral profiling, or use analytics on the dashboard. The service relies on the following providers:

  • Discord, for authentication and access to Discord resources through its API.
  • MongoDB Atlas, for the database used by the dashboard and bot.
  • Vercel, for hosting and delivering the dashboard.

These providers may process information under their own terms and privacy documentation. Depending on the service and the processing involved, a provider may act as a processor or as an independent controller. Discord remains an independent controller for the data it processes on its own platform.

Independent third-party Discord bots and applications that share a server with Wody process information under their own privacy policies and arrangements. Wody does not control that processing and is not responsible for the independent processing carried out by unrelated providers. This does not reduce Wody’s own responsibility for processing that Wody controls, or any obligation that applicable data protection law places on Wody. See Section 22 of the Terms.

sections.heading: 9. How long data is kept
sections.html: The wody_session browser cookie has a maximum lifetime of 7 days. This is the lifetime of the browser cookie, not a guarantee that the server-side session or Discord tokens remain valid for 7 days. The server-side dashboard session has its own expiry based on the Discord access token lifetime and is normally set to expire 60 seconds before that token. An expired session is rejected and its database record is removed when the session is checked. The wody_oauth_state cookie expires after 10 minutes and is removed immediately after the OAuth2 response is checked. Bot configuration and feature data are kept while they are needed to operate the relevant server features. Server owners can request deletion of applicable records by contacting us. Some records may need to be retained where required by law, necessary to establish or defend legal claims, or reasonably necessary for security, moderation history or Premium validation.

sections.heading: 10. Your rights
sections.html:
Where applicable under GDPR and other data protection law, you may have the right to request access, correction, deletion, restriction of processing, objection to processing and data portability. Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw that consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.

To exercise your rights or ask what information is associated with your Discord account, contact privacy@wody.online. We may ask you to verify your Discord identity before providing account information or processing a request. You may also lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority, including ANSPDCP in Romania.

sections.heading: 11. Data relating to other server members
sections.html: If you use Wody as a server owner or authorised staff member, the dashboard and bot may display or store information about other members when required by the features you use, such as moderation records, levels, tickets, suggestions or giveaways. This information may come from Discord, from the member directly, or from the server owner or staff using Wody. Server owners and staff are responsible for using that information lawfully and only for appropriate server management purposes. Depending on the feature, the server owner may be the controller for member data entered or managed through Wody, while Wody may process that data on the owner’s behalf.

sections.heading: 12. International processing
sections.html: Discord, MongoDB Atlas and Vercel may process information in countries outside Romania or the European Economic Area. Where a transfer to a third country is subject to GDPR Chapter V, the transfer is made only where an applicable legal mechanism is available, such as an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards including standard contractual clauses, where applicable. Information about the relevant safeguards can be requested from the Operator at the contact address above.

sections.heading: 13. Sources and automated decisions
sections.html: Personal data may be obtained directly from you, from Discord when you authorise the Wody application, or from server owners and authorised staff when they configure and use Wody. Wody does not use your personal data for automated decision-making or profiling that produces legal effects or similarly significant effects on you.

sections.heading: 14. YouTube Notifications and YouTube API Services
sections.html:
Wody provides YouTube Notifications to detect and deliver notifications about new content from configured YouTube channels. WebSub is the primary notification method. WebSub callbacks are received over HTTPS and, where provided by the service, the callback signature is verified before processing.

If a notification cannot be obtained or processed through WebSub, Wody may use the official YouTube Data API as a fallback. Wody does not scrape YouTube, use browser automation, or parse YouTube pages to obtain video information.

For this feature, Wody may process and temporarily store channel identifiers, video identifiers, video URLs, titles and other metadata returned by YouTube services, notification timestamps, delivery and processing status, deduplication identifiers, and limited technical information required to validate, queue, retry, or troubleshoot notifications. WebSub notifications may be retained temporarily while awaiting processing or retry.

Wody uses identifiers and processing records to prevent duplicate notifications. Video content itself is not downloaded or re-hosted by Wody.

Wody does not collect YouTube passwords or other YouTube account credentials through YouTube Notifications. This feature does not give Wody permission to like, subscribe, comment, generate views, or modify videos on behalf of users.

Where Wody uses YouTube API Services, use of the feature is also subject to the applicable YouTube Terms of Service and Google Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 15. Public showcase of servers using Wody
sections.html: The homepage displays a rotating selection of Discord servers that use Wody, under the “Servers already using Wody” heading. A server is included there automatically once the bot is a member of it and its member count exceeds a threshold we configure (currently more than 5 members), with no separate opt-in step required from the server owner. Only information Discord already makes publicly available through its own API is shown: the server’s name, its icon, and an approximate member count. No member list, message content, channel names or any other server data is displayed. When more servers qualify than fit on screen, a random subset is shown and rotates periodically rather than displaying every qualifying server at once. If you are a server owner and would prefer your server not appear in this showcase, contact privacy@wody.online and we will exclude it.

sections.heading: 16. Economy and Wody Games (virtual currency)
sections.html:
When Premium Economy or Wody Games (Slots, Coinflip, Dice and Blackjack) is used in a server, Wody stores, per server, the Discord user ID and server ID together with the data needed for the game: virtual balances (wallet, bank, savings, gems, Blackjack chips), inventory, pets, businesses, farm plots, job, quests, achievements, statistics, daily reward timestamps and streaks, market listings and trades, and Blackjack sessions and hand history.

Economy and Blackjack use virtual currency only. It has no real-world value, cannot be bought, sold or withdrawn through Wody, and is not connected to real money. Balances are separate for every server and are not shared between servers.

Transactions and administrative actions (action, amount, member, administrator) are kept in server logs so that disputes and abuse can be reviewed. Administrators with access to the dashboard or the admin tools can see these logs and can reset economy data. Retention: admin and economy logs 365 days, closed trades 30 days, Blackjack hand history 90 days, settled Blackjack sessions 7 days. Other game data is kept until a server administrator resets it or you ask us to delete it.

Global economy leaderboard. Wody publishes a ranking of the 100 richest members across all servers where Wody Economy is used, on Discord (command /globalleaderboard) and on the website (page /leaderboard). For each ranked member it shows the Discord display name, the avatar, the total net worth (the sum of the member’s balances on every server) and the number of servers. The ranking is calculated from economy data the bot already stores, refreshed about every 5 minutes and kept as one snapshot in the database. Bots are not ranked. Any member can leave the ranking at any time with the Hide me button under /globalleaderboard and come back with Show me; the choice is stored as the member’s Discord user ID in a list of hidden members and removes the member from the snapshot immediately. Avatars on the website are loaded through Wody’s own servers, so visitors’ browsers do not contact Discord or other third parties and no cookies are set.

sections.heading: 17. Birthdays
sections.html:
Birthdays is free and independent from Economy. A member sets a birthday with /birthday. Wody then stores the Discord user ID and server ID, the day and month, an optional birth year, a privacy level (public, community or private), an optional time zone and an on or off switch. Birth year is optional and is never required.

Privacy levels: public shows the date to the server; community uses the birthday for features such as announcements and reminders while keeping the exact date hidden from other members; private is never listed, announced or shown to other members. Age is displayed only when the server enables it, a birth year was provided and the birthday is not private.

Server administrators with dashboard access can see and manage all entries of their own server in the administration list, including private ones, but private birthdays are never shown in the calendar, in public boards or in announcements. A short history is kept of each celebration (date, whether it was announced, whether the birthday role was added and removed, and any delivery error). You can remove your birthday at any time with /birthday, and administrators can remove entries. Data is kept until it is removed.

sections.heading: 18. Stream Notifications (Twitch, Kick ve TikTok)
sections.html:
Stream Notifications is a Premium feature. For Twitch, Wody stores the public Twitch login, ID, display name and avatar of each streamer an administrator adds, the Discord channel and message settings, and technical subscription data for Twitch EventSub. Incoming Twitch events are processed to post the alert; event records are kept for 7 days and delivery records for 30 days to prevent duplicate messages.

For TikTok, an administrator can connect their own TikTok account through the official TikTok Login Kit. After consent, Wody stores the TikTok open ID, username, display name and avatar and the access and refresh tokens. The tokens are encrypted on the server (AES-256-GCM), are never shown in the dashboard and are never sent to your browser. Wody uses the scopes you approve to read only the connected creator’s own video list (video ID, title, description, creation time, cover image, link and duration) to announce new videos. Wody does not post to TikTok, does not read private messages and does not use TikTok data for advertising or sell it. A server owner who already linked their own TikTok account on the TikTok page can add that same account to a server with one click; Wody then stores an encrypted copy of the same connection for that server, and removing the account from the server deletes that copy only.

You can disconnect a TikTok account at any time in the dashboard. Wody then revokes the token and deletes the stored connection. You can also remove access in your TikTok settings. Wody does not offer alerts for TikTok creators who have not connected their own account. Twitch and TikTok are independent services with their own privacy policies.

Requests made from the dashboard to the bot (for example test messages) are stored temporarily and deleted after 24 hours.

Wody Creator Link (the TikTok page on wody.online): a signed-in Wody user can link their own TikTok account with TikTok Login Kit to see their TikTok profile and latest videos inside Wody. Wody stores the TikTok open ID, username, display name, avatar and the encrypted tokens, only for that user, only read access, and deletes them when the user unlinks the account on the page. Wody does not post to TikTok and does not use this data for advertising.

Wody Human Check (the "I’m not a robot" box used on verification and Collab forms): it uses no cookies, no local storage and no outside service. A short browser challenge and how the box was ticked (such as pointer movement and timing) are sent once to Wody, scored in memory and not stored. Only a one-time token marker is kept for a few minutes to stop reuse.

sections.heading: 19. Community Discovery
sections.html:
Community Discovery lets the owner of a Discord server publish a public profile for it at wody.online/{prefix}/{name}. A profile is shown only after a person on the Wody team has reviewed and approved it. The address prefix is chosen by Wody and may change; older addresses keep redirecting.

What we store. The profile content you enter (name, descriptions, category, tags, languages, invite code, social links, chosen colors and images, the Discord roles you choose to show publicly), the Discord server ID and public statistics read through the Discord bot (member count, online count, voice count, boosts, icon, creation date), your Discord user ID as the listing owner, the people you add as managers, the submission history, review decisions and messages, and the date you accepted the Terms and the Privacy Policy when submitting.

Visitors. Favorites, reviews and reports are linked to the Discord account that made them. A review shows the reviewer’s Discord name and avatar after moderation, and only members of the server can review it. Wody staff can see who wrote a review or report. Internal moderation notes are never shown to listing owners.

Analytics. Profile views, invite clicks and unique visitors are counted without cookies. A unique visitor is estimated from a one way daily hash of the IP address and browser string with a secret salt that changes every day. The raw IP address and browser string are not stored with the count, and the short lived technical records used for de-duplication are deleted after 2 days. Invite clicks only show that the Join button was pressed, not that someone joined.

Retention. Notifications are deleted after 90 days. When a listing is deleted by its owner or by Wody, the listing, its versions, reviews, favorites, reports, managers, images and notifications are removed and the public address becomes available again. A short audit entry (listing name, address, who deleted it and when) is kept for moderation and legal reasons. Suspended and unpublished listings are kept until deleted.

Legal basis and sharing. Profile content is published at your request (contract) and moderation is carried out under our legitimate interest in keeping the directory safe. We do not sell this data. Public profile content, including the invite you provide, can be seen by anyone and may be indexed by search engines while the listing is published. Unpublished, suspended and unapproved listings are not indexed.

Rules. What may be listed and what is stored about listed servers is also summarised in the Community Guidelines.

Expiry notices. For each published listing we store the date until which it is public and the dates of renewals. We use them to send you a website notification and a Discord direct message 7 days before the listing ends and when it ends. A listing is public for 6 months unless it is renewed; after that it is taken off the directory and its data is kept until the owner deletes the listing. When a listing is submitted for review, the Wody team is told by a website notification and a Discord direct message that contains the server name, its ID and its member count.

sections.heading: 20. Invite Tracking
sections.html:
Invite Tracking is free and is off until a server administrator turns it on. When it is on, Wody reads the list of invites of the server (this needs the Manage Server permission) and compares the use counters before and after each join to work out which invite a member used.

What we store, per server. For every join: the Discord user ID of the member, the Discord user ID of the inviter, the invite code, the time of the join, whether the match was certain, and whether the member later left. For every invite: its code, the creator’s Discord user ID, the use counter and its limits. The server’s settings for the module (log and notice channels, messages, who can see statistics, the fake account threshold) are stored too. When Wody cannot be sure, the join is stored as unknown with the reason and nobody is credited.

Why and who can see it. The data is used only to show invite statistics, leaderboards, join logs and the inviter variables of the welcome message in that server. Members can see statistics with the commands, unless the server limits them to staff. Server administrators with dashboard access can see the recent joins and the leaderboard of their own server. Data of one server is never shown in another.

Deletion. Administrators can delete all invite statistics, or those of one member, from the dashboard or with /invite-reset. If Wody is removed from a server, the data of that server is deleted after 30 days. Invite Tracking never deletes the data of other modules.

sections.heading: 21. Servers where Wody is added
sections.html: When Wody is added to a server, it records the server ID, the server name and the time it joined, and when it is removed it records the same with the time it left. These records are kept so the Operator can see which servers use Wody and handle returns and bans, until deletion is requested (see Section 9). At the same time Wody posts a report to a private Discord channel controlled by the Operator. The report contains information Discord makes available to the bot: the server name, ID, icon and banner, the server owner’s Discord name and ID, the account that added the bot when the bot is allowed to read the audit log, the member count, creation date, language, boost level, verification level, the number of channels, roles, emojis and stickers, the vanity link, description, the name of the rules channel and the server features, plus whether the server is banned or has Premium. A second private message shows only aggregate totals and counts about the bot and the website. The purpose is to operate, secure and support the service, detect abuse and enforce bans (legitimate interest). The report does not include messages or member lists.

sections.heading: 22. WODY Passport
sections.html:
When someone claims a passport with /claimpassport, Wody keeps a small record for the Discord account: the Discord user ID, a passport number generated by Wody (the first 1000 passports also carry a Genesis number from 1 to 1000, given in the order they were claimed), the date it was claimed, and one counter: how many times other members displayed the passport (one count per viewer per hour). Wody does not count the commands you use or the days you are active. Wody does not store the display name or avatar for the passport; they are read from Discord when a card is drawn, and a finished card image is only kept briefly in the memory of the running bot.

To show the number of server bans, Wody stores pairs of Discord user ID and server ID for servers that use Wody where the account is banned. They are learned from ban and unban events and from a check of the servers where Wody may see the ban list, made when a passport is claimed and then at most once a day when its owner displays it. A pair is removed when the ban is lifted or when Wody is removed from the server. Only the number appears on the card, never the names of the servers or the reasons. Earlier versions kept a list of servers the account was a member of; those records have been deleted. A short-lived keyed hash is kept for one hour to avoid counting the same view twice. The purpose is to provide the feature the user requested (legitimate interest and, for the feature itself, the performance of the service). The passport record is kept while the feature is available; you can ask for it to be deleted by contacting us, subject to the exceptions in Section 9.

sections.heading: 23. Owner Panel access and audit log
sections.html: Access to the Owner Panel is limited to the Operator and to people the Operator explicitly authorises for the community management part, for a limited time. Wody stores the Discord user ID, display name and avatar link of those authorised people, who granted the access, and when it expires. Sign-ins and actions in the Owner Panel are recorded in an audit log with the Discord user ID, display name, action, result, time, and a short one-way tag derived from the IP address (not the address itself). The audit log is kept for up to one year and each entry is also posted to a private Discord channel used by the Operator. The purpose is the security of the service and accountability for administrative actions.

sections.heading: 24. Reports and moderation records
sections.html: Reports and moderation decisions in the official Wody Discord community, and reports sent to the Operator by email, are handled by the Operator and the community staff. They may include the reporter’s and the reported person’s Discord identifiers, the content reported, and the decision taken. This information is used to protect users and the service and to defend legal claims, is shared only with those who need it to handle the report, and may be disclosed where required by law. Absolute confidentiality cannot be promised because a report may need to be reviewed in order to be investigated. See the Community Guidelines for how to report.

sections.heading: 25. WODY Collab and your profile
sections.html:
WODY Collab stores what you put into it, tied to your Discord user ID: your collabs (text, category, tags, optional links and up to three images, with every version you submitted), the result of the automatic check and any moderation decision, reports made about a collab, your applications, and the messages exchanged between authors and applicants. Your Discord display name and avatar hash are copied into each collab and application so the other person can see who wrote it; a collab shows the author’s Discord name and picture and, when the author has a public profile, a link to it (the profile is visible to signed in members only). When a visitor uses the optional contact form of a collab, the name, reply contact and message the visitor types are stored in the author’s inbox, and no network address is stored with the message. Abuse is limited with the Wody Human Check and with per-collab limits instead.

Your Collab profile stores your preferences (categories, tags and language used for the For you section and for notifications), the social links you add (only addresses of the offered platforms, saved as canonical https links), the setting that decides whether the authors of collabs you apply to can see those links (off by default), and your notification settings. The social links are shown on your profile. Your Discord username, display name and avatar hash are copied into your Collab profile so that it can be opened by your username; they are refreshed from Discord each time you open your profile and cannot be edited here. Your profile is public: every signed in member can open it at wody.online/profile/{username} and see your name, picture, username, join date, vacation status and the number of your live collabs. If you connect your TikTok account on the TikTok page, your TikTok username is added to your profile automatically as a link to your TikTok profile (read from the account you linked, never typed in). You can hide the TikTok link with its own switch, and you can turn off the sharing of all your social links at any time; hidden links are not shown to anyone. Only signed in members can see a profile; visitors who are not signed in are sent to the login. Notifications are stored for 90 days and, if you leave them enabled, are also sent as a Discord direct message in your language. Notices about moderation of your own collab are always recorded in the profile; only their Discord message can be turned off.

To enforce the rule against prices and payment details, the text of a collab, an application or a message may be analysed by automatic rules and, when the operator has configured one, by an AI service. If the analysis fails, the collab is held for a person to review. Wody staff see reports, detected payment terms and the moderation history. Collab does not make decisions that produce legal effects about you by solely automated means: an automatic hold or suspension is placed in a queue for a person at Wody to review.

The purpose is to provide the feature you requested and to keep the board safe (legitimate interest and the performance of the service). Drafts and live collabs are kept while the feature is available. When you delete a collab it is hidden at once, its images are erased and its open applications are closed; its versions, checks, decisions and reports are kept as a moderation record, as described in Section 26. Applications and messages are kept while the collab exists and as long as needed for moderation. You can ask for deletion of your Collab data by contacting us, subject to the exceptions in Section 9. See also the Terms.

When you add an image to a collab by link, our server downloads that address once, checks that the file really is a PNG, JPEG or WebP image and stores a copy with your other collab images. Only a short file name taken from the address is kept, nothing that identifies you is sent to the other site (no cookies and no referrer), and visitors only ever load our copy. Your optional vacation status (an on/off switch, a short note of up to 120 characters and an optional end date) is stored in your Collab profile. While it is on, it is shown on your profile and to people who open your collabs or read your applications; it switches off by itself after the end date.

Server owners can create their own Collab categories for their server in the Dashboard. For each category Wody stores the server ID, the name the owner chose, who may post in it (everyone in the server, members with chosen Discord roles, or only the server staff), the IDs of the chosen roles, who created it and when. A category belongs to one server only: other servers cannot see it or use it, and two servers can use the same name. To decide whether you may post in a restricted category, Wody reads your roles in that server from Discord at the moment you post; those roles are not stored. The Collab settings a server owner chooses in the Dashboard (approval and announcement channel) are stored with the server ID.

To prevent abuse of posting, Collab keeps short lived records of when you posted and deleted collabs (your Discord user ID, the server ID and a time). They are used for the posting cooldown, the daily limit per server and temporary pauses, and the database removes them automatically after 24 hours.

Expiry notices. Each collab is stored with the date it ends, 30 days after it goes live or is renewed. We use that date to send the author a website notification and a Discord direct message 7 days before it ends and when it ends. An ended collab that is not renewed within 7 days is deleted automatically, together with its images and files.

sections.heading: 26. Changes to this Policy
sections.html: This Policy may be updated when the service or its data processing practices change. The revision date shown above identifies the current version. Material changes may also be announced through the official Wody community channels where appropriate.

sections.heading: 27. Profil görselleri, müzik bağlantıları ve moderasyon kayıtları
sections.html: Profil sayfana ve sunucu kartlarına eklediğin görseller ve GIF’ler ile bağladığın sesler yalnızca bağlantı olarak saklanır: Wody bir kopya tutmaz. Görseller, onları barındıran platformdan Wody sunucusu üzerinden yüklenir; bu yüzden ziyaretçinin IP adresi o platforma ulaşmaz; yalnızca bağlantı geçerli olduğu sürece görünür kalırlar. Bağlı bir ses dosyası, ziyaretçi oynat’a bastıktan sonra doğrudan tarayıcısı tarafından yüklenir; bu yüzden IP adresi dosyayı barındıran siteye ulaşır. Senin yüklediğin şarkıyı ise Wody’nin kendisi sunar, bu da yalnızca ziyaretçi oynat’a bastıktan sonra olur. Wody’nin sakladığı tek dosyalar, profil kartı arka planı olarak yüklediğin bir görsel ile profil sayfana yüklediğin bir şarkıdır; her biri sen değiştirene veya silene kadar ya da bir bildirim sonrası kaldırılana kadar tutulur. Yüklenen şarkı için Wody ayrıca hak onayının zamanını ve sürümünü de saklar. Wody; bildirimleri, içerik referansını, moderasyon kararını ve geçmişini, ayrıca politika onayının zamanını ve sürümünü vakayı ele almak ve tekrarlanan ihlalleri önlemek için saklar. Profil sayfası, görüntülenmeleri veritabanında basit bir sayaçla, çerez kullanmadan ve IP adresini saklamadan sayabilir.

sections.heading: 28. Radar ve Pulse (sorgular ve akışlar)
sections.html: Bir üye /radar sorgusu çalıştırdığında, yazdığı metin (örneğin bir kullanıcı adı, sunucu adresi veya madeni para adı) yanıtı almak için seçilen hizmete gönderilir. Bir sunucu yöneticisi /pulse akışı eklediğinde, girdiği adres veya ad sunucu ayarlarında saklanır ve kaynak hizmette belirli aralıklarla kontrol edilir. Bu istekleri Wody sunucusu yapar, bu nedenle üyenin IP adresi hizmete ulaşmaz. Wody sorgu sonuçlarını yalnızca kısa süreli bir önbellekte tutar ve akışların içeriğini saklamaz; yalnızca aynı öğeyi iki kez paylaşmamak için gerekeni saklar. Her hizmet kendi gizlilik politikasını uygular.

sections.heading: 29. Sayma oyunları
sections.html:
Bir sunucu bir kanalda sayma oyununu açtığında Wody, o kanaldaki mesajları yalnızca her birinin sıradaki sayı olup olmadığını denetlemek için okur. Bir mesajın metni bellekte denetlenir ve asla saklanmaz. Wody sayaçları saklar: kanal ve sunucu kimlikleri, sunucunun seçtiği oyun ayarları, şu anki sayı ve tur ve katılan her üye için Discord kullanıcı kimliği ile birlikte geçerli sayı, hata, seri, en yüksek sayı, kurtarma, sayma XP, rozet ve alınan ödül adetleri. Aynı mesajın iki kez sayılmaması veya ödüllendirilmemesi için bir mesaj kimliği kısa süre saklanır ve oyun başına günlük toplamlar hiçbir üye verisi olmadan saklanır.

Sayma bu sayaçları oyun var olduğu sürece saklar. Günlük toplamlar yaklaşık 400 gün sonra, biten turlar yaklaşık 730 gün sonra ve sahibin yaptığı değişikliklere ilişkin denetim kayıtları yaklaşık 365 gün sonra silinir. Sunucu yöneticisi bir sayımı sıfırlayabilir, bir oyunu arşivleyebilir veya herkese açık listeden her an çıkarabilir. Bir oyun herkese açıksa herkese açık sayfalar oyun adını, modu, rekoru, toplamları ve en iyi sayanların Discord’da göründüğü görünen adlarını avatar ve mesaj metni olmadan gösterir. Sayma verileri reklam veya profilleme için kullanmaz ve genel XP’yi, Economy’yi veya Moderation’ı değiştirmez. Sayma sayaçlarının silinmesini isteyen bir üye aşağıdaki iletişim adresine yazabilir.

sections.heading: 30. İstatistikler
sections.html:
İstatistikler, sunucu sahibinin açması gereken isteğe bağlı bir modüldür. Açıkken Wody, sunucudaki her yeni mesajı yalnızca ilgili kanal, gün (UTC) ve saat için bir sayaca 1 eklemek amacıyla okur. Mesaj metni, ekler ve yazarın kimliği saklanmaz. Kaç farklı kişinin yazdığını tahmin etmek için Wody, yazarın tuzlu ve tek yönlü bir özetini kanal ve gün başına küçük bir olasılıksal taslağa (HyperLogLog) ekler. Tuz sunucuya özeldir ve sahip verileri sildiğinde değiştirilir; taslak bir kullanıcı kimliğine veya ada geri çevrilemez. Bot mesajları, webhook mesajları ve sahibin hariç tuttuğu kanallar veya kategoriler sayılmaz. Günlük katılım ve ayrılmalar, Wody’nin sunucu için zaten tuttuğu üye sayaçlarından gelir.

İstatistikler sayaçlarını sahibin belirlediği süre boyunca (30 ile 365 gün arası, varsayılan 90) saklar ve daha eski sayaçları otomatik olarak siler. Sahip, tüm sayaçları istediği zaman panodan veya /statistics komutundan silebilir; bu işlem tuzu da değiştirir. Veriler yalnızca sahibe ve sahip izin verirse sunucu üyelerine sunucunun ne kadar etkin olduğunu Discord’da, panoda ve PDF raporlarında göstermek için kullanılır. Reklam veya profilleme için kullanılmaz; genel XP’yi, Economy’yi veya Moderation’ı değiştirmez. Katılımcı rakamları tahmindir. İstatistikler mümkün olan en az veriyi saklamak üzere tasarlanmıştır, ancak sunucunuzun KVKK/GDPR veya başka bir yasaya uyduğu anlamına gelen bir beyan değildir: bunları kullanıp kullanmayacağına ve nasıl kullanacağına karar vermekten sunucu sahibi sorumludur. Bu sayaçlar hakkında sorusu olan bir üye aşağıdaki iletişim adresine yazabilir.

sections.heading: 31. Contact
sections.html:
For privacy, legal, or data protection questions, contact Păcurar Ancuța-Narcisa, the Operator, at privacy@wody.online.

Wody may also use the optional wody_language preference cookie to remember a language you actively choose. It is not created or updated unless you consent to Preferences, and the language selector remains hidden until that consent exists. Your cookie choice is recorded using the strictly necessary wody_cookie_consent cookie. You can change or withdraw the optional preference at any time in the Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: 1. Who you’re dealing with
sections.html: Wody, the Discord bot and this dashboard, is operated by Păcurar Ancuța-Narcisa, an individual based in Romania, European Union (the "Operator"). Reach us at contact@wody.online. The service has no affiliation with, endorsement from, or sponsorship by Discord Inc.

sections.heading: 2. Agreeing to these Terms
sections.html: By inviting Wody to a Discord server, logging into the dashboard or otherwise using the service, you agree to be bound by these Terms, our Privacy Policy, our Cookie Policy, our Community Guidelines, and Discord’s own Terms of Service and Community Guidelines. If any of that doesn’t work for you, please don’t use the service.

sections.heading: 3. Definitions
sections.html:
For the purposes of these Terms and the related policies, the following definitions apply:

Wody - Wody is our Discord bot and includes the modules and features made available through the bot and its services.

Dashboard - The Dashboard is this website and its management interface, where authorized users can configure and manage Wody and access the available settings and functionality.

sections.heading: 4. What Wody actually does
sections.html:
Wody is a Discord bot paired with this web dashboard. The homepage presents 20 modules covering the core community management features below, with changes configured from the dashboard and applied without a bot restart. The service is free to use, while Premium access is invitation-only and unlocks additional features and higher limits. Between them they cover:

  • Welcome & Auto Role: custom welcome messages, DMs and auto-role assignment on join. Embed or plain text with dynamic placeholders.
  • Goodbye: sends a farewell embed when a member leaves the server. Fully customizable.
  • Moderation: all the essentials, including /ban, /kick, /timeout, /warn, /purge, /slowmode, /lock, warnings history and mod-log persistence.
  • Automod: layered protection for spam, invites, links, mentions, raids, scams, phishing, bad words, caps, duplicates and message floods with a role whitelist.
  • Tickets: button panels, private channels per user, claim by staff, closable with automatic transcript export. Standard servers can have up to 1 ticket panel; Premium servers have no limit.
  • Reaction Roles: four modes (normal, toggle, unique, verify) covering self-assignable roles. Standard servers can have up to 1 reaction role panel; Premium servers have no limit.
  • Captcha: new members verify on a dedicated web page before a configured role is granted.
  • Giveaways: one-click entry, automatic ends, reroll winners. Standard servers can have up to 1 active giveaway; Premium servers have no limit.
  • Levels: XP-per-message with cooldown, level-up messages in a dedicated channel, /rank and /leaderboard.
  • Suggestions: members submit ideas, moderators approve or deny with buttons, and the embed history is preserved.
  • Auto Responses: trigger-based automatic replies, case-insensitive, with an exact-match option. Standard servers can have up to 5 auto responses; Premium servers have no limit.
  • Custom Commands: simple prefix-based text commands, perfect for !rules, !info, !partners and every FAQ answer. Standard servers can have up to 5 custom commands; Premium servers have no limit.
  • Embed Builder: design and send rich embeds with title, description, color, footer, image and thumbnail straight to any channel.
  • Scheduled Messages: sends plain text or embeds at a set time, once or on a repeating interval, fully managed from the dashboard. Standard servers can have up to 1 active scheduled message; Premium servers have no limit.
  • Forums: automatic tagging and cooldown policy applied to forum posts. Standard servers can have up to 1 configured forum channel; Premium servers have no limit.
  • Full logging: message delete/edit, nickname changes, member join/leave and every mod action logged with timestamps.
  • Pools: create pools with multiple answers, schedule them to close automatically, collect member votes and view live or final results.
  • Vote: a command that lets you vote for Wody on listed bot directories, with your lifetime vote total tracked against your Discord account.
  • Backups, Premium: snapshot roles and channels, restore in one command.
  • Temporary Voice, Premium: join-to-create dynamic voice channels.
  • YouTube Notifications, Premium: automatic Discord alerts when a chosen YouTube channel uploads.

We may modify, suspend, or discontinue features at any time. The service is provided "as is" and "as available", without any warranty that it will be error-free or uninterrupted, subject to any rights that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited.

Any uptime statement, including a 24/7 uptime target, is a target and does not guarantee uninterrupted availability.

sections.heading: 5. Who can use it
sections.html: You must meet the minimum age required by Discord for your country or region, including any higher minimum age required by applicable local law, to use Discord and, through it, Wody. Wody does not set a separate lower age limit and does not override Discord’s age requirements. If applicable law requires consent from a parent or legal guardian for your use of an online service or for a particular processing activity, that requirement continues to apply. To change any setting for a server through this dashboard, you must be that server’s owner, or hold a role the bot recognizes as authorized to manage it. You are responsible for making sure your use of the service follows the laws and mandatory rules that apply to you. Wody is made available internationally, but the service is not represented as lawful or appropriate for every person, purpose or jurisdiction. Where the use of a feature is restricted or unlawful under applicable law, you must not use that feature. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits rights or protections that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited in your jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 6. Rules of use
sections.html:
You won’t use the service to:

  • Break Discord’s Terms of Service, Community Guidelines, or any law that applies to you;
  • Spam, phish, spread malware, run raids, mass-DM, or harass anyone;
  • Try to exploit, reverse-engineer, overload, or gain unauthorized access to the bot, the dashboard, its API, or its database, except where expressly permitted by applicable law;
  • Impersonate someone else or misrepresent your relationship to a server;
  • Pull personal data on other Discord users beyond what Discord’s own APIs already expose through normal use;
  • Do anything illegal or that infringes someone else’s rights.

You are responsible for granting the bot only the permissions you intend it to have and for reviewing those permissions before inviting it to a server. Breaking any of this can get your access cut off, the bot removed from the server involved, the server blacklisted, and where warranted, reported to Discord Trust & Safety or the relevant authorities.

The Community Guidelines explain what is expected from members of the official Wody Discord community. They apply alongside these Terms. If something is covered by both, the stricter protection for users and the service applies, without limiting any right you have under applicable law.

sections.heading: 7. Content you configure
sections.html: Anything you write into the bot, welcome messages, custom commands, auto responses, ticket text and similar, is stored so the bot can use it, as described in our Privacy Policy. You retain ownership of the content you submit. You’re responsible for that content: that you have the right to use it, and that it doesn’t break the law, infringe anyone’s rights, or violate Discord’s own rules.

sections.heading: 8. YouTube Notifications and YouTube
sections.html:
The YouTube Notifications feature may use WebSub as its primary method for receiving notifications from configured YouTube channels. WebSub callbacks are received over HTTPS and, where available, relevant callback signatures are verified before processing. The official YouTube Data API may be used as a fallback when necessary.

Wody does not use scraping, browser automation, or parsing of YouTube pages to provide this feature, and does not download or re-host videos. Wody may process and temporarily store channel and video identifiers, metadata returned by YouTube services, notification timestamps, delivery and processing status, deduplication identifiers, and limited technical information required to process, validate, retry, or prevent duplicate notifications.

YouTube Notifications do not collect YouTube passwords or other account credentials and do not authorize Wody to like, subscribe, comment, create views, or modify videos on a user’s behalf.

Your use of YouTube Notifications is also subject to the applicable YouTube Terms of Service. By using this feature, you agree to comply with applicable YouTube terms and policies.

sections.heading: 9. Premium
sections.html:
Premium is free and no payment changes hands, so there is nothing to refund and Premium has no monetary purchase price. The homepage describes Premium as invitation-only. It unlocks Backups, Temporary Voice channels, YouTube Notifications, Economy, Wody Games, Stream Notifications, server seasons in the Battle Pass and Theme Studio, and removes the creation limits on seven core systems. There are two ways to get it:

  • Discretionary grant: usually to server owners who actively promote Wody, approved manually after you reach out in our community server;
  • Vote unlock: use the /vote command to vote for Wody on the bot directories it links you to; once your lifetime vote total on your Discord account reaches 100, open a ticket in our community server to claim your Premium key, which can then be activated on any server you own.

A Premium key is rate-limited, tied to the account or promotion it was issued for, and can be activated on one server at a time. We can grant, withhold, revoke or pull premium access at any time, for any reason, including if the promotion behind it turns out to be fake, if votes are found to be manipulated or automated, or if the underlying directory removes the vote.

Yeni: oy günleri. top.gg üzerinde Wody için verilen her oy hesabına bir gün ekler. Günler hesap başına sayılır, devredilemez veya satılamaz ve istediğin miktarda, bir günden başlayarak etkinleştirilebilir. Etkinleştirme, seçtiğin günleri sahibi olduğun tek bir sunucuya Premium süresi olarak ekler; panelden veya /redeemvotes ile yapılır. Otomatik, satın alınmış veya manipüle edilmiş oylardan gelen günleri ya da Premium süresini kaldırabiliriz.

sections.heading: 10. Uptime and Availability
sections.html:
Wody is designed to be available continuously, and the homepage lists a 24/7 uptime target. This is an operational target, not a promise that the service will be available without interruption. Like any online service, Wody may experience temporary downtime, maintenance, technical failures, hosting incidents, Discord API or platform outages, network problems, or other events outside our reasonable control. We do not guarantee a specific uptime percentage, response time, or uninterrupted availability, and features may be added, changed, limited or removed when necessary.

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, we are not liable for downtime arising from maintenance, hosting incidents, hardware failures, software bugs, third-party API changes, or any interruption to the service.

sections.heading: 11. Security and where our responsibility ends
sections.html:
We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect the service, including signed HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite session cookies, a short-lived OAuth2 state check, HTTPS encryption, server-side authorization checks and established infrastructure providers such as MongoDB Atlas and Vercel. The dashboard session data and Discord OAuth tokens are kept server side rather than inside the browser authentication cookie. The browser session cookie can remain for up to 7 days, while the server-side session may expire sooner based on the Discord access token lifetime. More detail is available in our Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy.

No online service can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Wody is operated by an individual rather than a registered company. To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the Operator shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, consequential or special damages arising out of or relating to the use of the service. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability, rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited under applicable law.

You give the bot permissions on your server at your own risk. Review what it asks for before inviting it, and keep your own backup of anything on your server that you would be unable to replace.

sections.heading: 12. Indemnification
sections.html: To the extent permitted by applicable law, you agree to indemnify and hold the Operator harmless from claims, losses and reasonable legal expenses arising directly from your use of the service, your breach of these Terms, or your violation of someone else’s rights, to the extent such claims arise from your unlawful use of the service.

sections.heading: 13. Ending things
sections.html: Remove the bot from your server and log out of the dashboard whenever you want to stop. We can suspend or end your access, or the bot’s presence anywhere, at any time, with or without prior notice, where reasonably practicable, including where necessary to protect the service, other users or comply with legal obligations, or for shutting the whole service down.

sections.heading: 14. Ownership
sections.html: The Wody name, logo, and the dashboard’s design belong to the Operator. You get a limited, revocable license to use the service as intended. Copying, redistributing, or creating derivative works from the code, design, or branding needs our written permission first.

sections.heading: 15. Force majeure
sections.html: Neither party shall be liable for delays or failures caused by events beyond reasonable control, including natural disasters, internet outages, hosting failures, Discord service interruptions or governmental actions.

sections.heading: 16. Economy and Wody Games
sections.html:
Economy and Wody Games are Premium modules. All coins, gems, chips, items, pets and other game values are virtual. They have no monetary value, cannot be exchanged for real money, goods or services, and Wody does not offer gambling for real money. Chips can be converted into Economy coins only at the rate and within the daily limits set by the server administrators.

Server administrators configure prices, rewards, taxes, limits, events and resets for their server and are responsible for those choices. Game data may be reset by administrators or by Wody to correct errors, and we do not guarantee that virtual balances or items will be kept forever or restored after a reset.

You must not use scripts, automation, duplication bugs, multiple accounts or any other method to gain an unfair advantage. We and server administrators may remove balances or items obtained this way and may restrict access to the module.

sections.heading: 17. Birthdays
sections.html:
Birthdays is free. Members choose whether to share a birthday and with which privacy level. You must only enter information that is accurate and that you are entitled to share, and you must not enter another person’s birthday without their permission.

Server administrators may use the module only to celebrate members and must respect the privacy level chosen by each member. Administrators are responsible for how they use the data they can see in their own server. Birthday roles and messages depend on the permissions you grant to Wody.

sections.heading: 18. Stream Notifications
sections.html:
Stream Notifications is a Premium module that posts alerts for Twitch streams and, for creators who connect their own account, TikTok videos. You may add a streamer or connect a TikTok account only if you are entitled to do so, and you must follow the terms of Twitch and TikTok, including the Twitch Developer Services Agreement and the TikTok developer terms.

Alerts depend on third party services. Twitch and TikTok can change, limit or stop their interfaces at any time, so we cannot guarantee that every alert will be sent, or sent on time. TikTok alerts are available only for accounts that have been connected through the official TikTok login. We may disable a provider if this is required by its terms or by law. Alert text is written by server administrators, who are responsible for it.

sections.heading: 19. Community Discovery
sections.html:
Community Discovery is a public directory of Discord communities. By submitting a listing you confirm that you have read and accept these Terms and the Privacy Policy.

Eligibility. Only the owner of a Discord server, or a person with the permissions required by Wody, can create a listing for it. You must have the Wody bot in the server. One server can have one listing.

Your content. You are responsible for everything in your listing, including the invite, images and links. It must be accurate, must not impersonate a person, brand or other server, and must follow the Community Guidelines at /servers/guidelines. You give Wody a free, non exclusive licence to display the content in the directory, in search results and in link previews while the listing is published. You keep ownership of your content.

Review and publication. Every listing and every later change is reviewed by Wody before it becomes public. Wody can approve, ask for changes, reject, suspend, unpublish or delete a listing at its discretion, for example for breaking these Terms, for a broken invite, for reports or for abuse. Approval is not an endorsement and Wody is not responsible for what happens inside a listed server or for the conduct of its members.

Names and addresses. Each public address and community name can be used by one listing at a time. We may refuse or change a name or address that is misleading, reserved, or already in use. Addresses are not property: a deleted listing frees its address, and Wody may reassign reserved or abandoned ones.

Reviews and reports. Reviews can be written only by members of the server and are moderated. Fake, paid, abusive or off topic reviews and links in reviews are removed. Listing owners cannot review their own server. Reports are handled by the Wody team and the outcome is at its discretion.

No guarantees. Listing position, featuring and badges are decided by Wody and can change. We do not guarantee any number of views, clicks or members. Features can be changed or removed. Custom domains are not offered.

Duration and renewal. A published listing stays public for 6 months. During the last 7 days before it ends, and after it has ended, the owner can renew it from the server dashboard to keep it online for another 6 months. Wody sends a Discord direct message and a website notification 7 days before the end date and again when the listing ends. A listing that is not renewed is taken off the directory automatically. Its content is kept and the owner can put it back online by renewing it.

sections.html:
Wody may be used alongside independent Discord bots, applications, integrations, and other external services. Unless expressly stated otherwise, these services are operated by their respective providers and are not controlled by Wody.

Wody does not guarantee the availability, functionality, reliability, security, data handling, moderation decisions, or performance of independent third-party services. Users and server administrators are responsible for evaluating the permissions, configuration, terms of service, and privacy policies of the external services they choose to use.

The presence of a third-party bot on a Discord server where Wody is also installed does not mean that the third-party bot is developed, operated, approved, or controlled by Wody.

References to, recommendations of, integrations with, or partnerships involving third-party services do not, by themselves, constitute a guarantee of their safety, reliability, compliance, or performance. Any additional commitments must be assessed according to the actual terms of the relevant partnership or written agreement.

To the extent permitted by applicable law, Wody is not responsible for the independent actions or omissions of third-party providers that are outside Wody’s control. Nothing in this section excludes or limits liability, consumer rights, data protection obligations, or other legal responsibilities that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited. This section does not limit Wody’s responsibility for its own conduct, systems, or legal obligations.

To keep these categories clear, the following are different things and are not covered by identical practices or commitments:

  • Wody: the Discord bot and this Dashboard, operated by the Operator.
  • Partners: services presented on our Partners page because of an actual relationship with them. Partner status does not guarantee the quality, availability, security, legality, or performance of a partner service, and each partner remains responsible for the services it operates, subject to applicable law and any agreement that actually exists.
  • Independent third-party bots and applications: services that merely share a Discord server with Wody.
  • External platforms: Discord, YouTube, Twitch, TikTok and the infrastructure providers named in our Privacy Policy, which have their own terms and privacy policies.

sections.heading: 21. WODY Passport
sections.html:
WODY Passport is a fictional community document generated by Wody for fun. It is not an identity document, it has no legal value, and it is not issued, verified, or endorsed by any government or by Discord.

Each Discord account can claim one global passport with /claimpassport. Nobody can claim it for someone else, and nothing is counted before it is claimed. Afterwards it is shown with /mypassport or /passport, and there is no separate switch. The card shows your Discord display name and avatar, a passport number generated by Wody, the claim date, the days since you claimed it, and the number of servers that use Wody in which you are banned.

The first 1000 passports ever claimed are Genesis passports. They get a Genesis number from 1 to 1000, given in the order of claiming, a special passport number and a black and gold card. The Genesis number never changes and is never reassigned to someone else.

The ban count only reflects servers that use Wody and where Wody is allowed to see the ban list. It can therefore be lower than the real number, it is not a statement about servers Wody cannot see, and each server decides its own bans. It is a number only, never the names of the servers or the reasons. Other members can display your passport in a channel with /passport. Bots do not have passports. A shared cooldown applies to the passport commands. Details of the data involved are in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 22. WODY Collab and your profile
sections.html:
WODY Collab is a board on the website where members post what they need (a "collab") and other members apply to help. Wody only provides the board and the messaging. Wody is not a party to any agreement between members, does not take part in, guarantee, supervise or verify any work, and does not handle payments, escrow or fees. Prices, budgets, payment terms and payment details are not allowed in a collab, in an application or in a message, and the automatic check and the WODY team may hold or remove content that contains them.

You are responsible for what you post, for the people you choose to work with, and for any arrangement you make outside Wody. Do not post unlawful, deceptive, unsafe, harassing or misleading content, do not impersonate anyone, and do not put personal contact details in public text. Members can report a collab. Several reports suspend it automatically until the WODY team has reviewed it. The WODY team and, for a collab posted for a server that turned on approval, the owner of that server, can approve, reject, ask for changes to, or suspend a collab. A suspended collab is hidden and cannot be edited until a decision is made. You can delete your own collabs from your profile, except while one is suspended or being checked.

Your profile is the one place where you manage your collabs, applications, messages, social links and notification settings. Your name, picture and Discord name always come from Discord and cannot be changed in the profile. The social links you add must point to the platforms offered there and must be your own. They are shown on your profile and, only if you switch it on, to the authors of the collabs you apply to. Your profile is public to every signed in member at wody.online/profile/{username}, and a TikTok account you connect is added to it automatically. By using the website and Collab you agree that your profile is public in this way; you can hide any social link, including TikTok, or turn sharing off in your profile settings. You can remove them at any time. You can turn Collab notifications on or off in your profile; notices about the moderation of your own collab are always recorded in the profile. Do not use the messaging or the notifications for spam or abuse. Wody may limit, suspend or remove access to Collab for abuse. Details of the data involved are in the Privacy Policy.

When you add an image to a collab by link, you confirm that you have the right to use and share it, and WODY stores a copy of it. Do not link to content that is unlawful or that you are not allowed to share. Your vacation status is visible to the people described in the Privacy Policy and must not contain contact details or personal data of anyone else.

Server owners can create categories for their own server in the Dashboard and decide who may post in them: everyone in the server, members with chosen roles, or only the server staff. A collab made for a server must use one of that server's own categories, so nobody can post for a server that has none. You can only post for a server you are a member of and only in a category you are allowed to use. The server owner and administrators can use every category of their server. The server owner is responsible for the category names and may change or delete them at any time; collabs in a deleted category move to Other Services.

To protect the board, Collab limits how often you can post: one new collab per minute, a limited number of new collabs per server per day, and no repeated posts with the same title. If you post and delete collabs again and again, posting is paused for 30 minutes. Wody may change these limits to stop abuse.

Duration and renewal. A collab stays live for 30 days. During the last 7 days, and after it has ended, the author can renew it from the profile to keep it live for another 30 days. Wody sends a Discord direct message and a website notification 7 days before the end date and again when the collab ends. An ended collab is hidden, and if the author does not renew it within 7 days it is deleted automatically.

howto.title: {module} nasıl kurulur
howto.intro: {module} modülünü sunucunda adım adım nasıl çalıştıracağını burada bulabilirsin. Birkaç dakika sürer.
howto.s1d: Wody’yi sunucuna davet et, Discord ile panele giriş yap ve sunucunu seç. Discord’da /dashboard komutuyla da bağlantıyı alabilirsin.
howto.s2d: Kenar çubuğundan {module} modülünü aç ve kapalıysa etkinleştir.
howto.premium: {module} Premium’a dahildir. Önce sunucun için bir anahtar etkinleştir, sonra modülü aç.
howto.s3d: İhtiyacın olanı seç ve kaydet. Değişiklikler bota anında ulaşır. Şunları ayarlayabilirsin:
howto.quick: Kısa bir Hızlı kurulum ilk adımlarda sana rehberlik eder. Atlayıp tüm ayarları açabilirsin.
howto.s4d: Bu komutlar sen ve üyelerin için hazır:
howto.s5d: Sunucunda dene. Bir şey eksikse, örneğin bir izin, Wody tam olarak neyin eksik olduğunu söyler ve paneldeki hata günlüğü de bunu gösterir. İstediğin zaman dönüp her şeyi değiştirebilirsin.

pools.ad: Üyelerin oy vereceği kanalda /pool create komutunu çalıştır. Soruyu yaz, | ile ayrılmış 2 ila 10 seçenek ekle ve ne kadar açık kalacağını belirle, örneğin 2h veya 1d. Birden fazla yanıta izin verebilir veya canlı sonuçları gizleyebilirsin.
pools.bd: Süre dolunca kendiliğinden kapanır. Daha erken kapatmak için anket mesajının kimliğiyle /pool end kullan. /pool results rakamları, /pool list ise etkin anketleri gösterir.

bump.ad: Panelde Community Discovery’yi aç, açıklamayı, kategoriyi, etiketleri ve dilleri doldur ve profili gönder. Yayına girmeden önce Wody ekibinden biri onu inceler.
bump.bd: Recently bumped listesinde yükselmek için sunucunda /bump kullan. Ücretsiz sunucular 2 saatte bir, Premium sunucular 30 dakikada bir bump yapabilir.

common.imageHostingTipIntro: En güvenilir yol, Discord’un senin için barındırmasıdır:

common.imageHostingFormat: Dosyayı 8 MB’ın altında tut. PNG, JPG ve WEBP hepsi çalışır, animasyonlu GIF’ler animasyonlu kalır.
common.imageUrlHint: Doğrudan HTTPS görsel veya GIF URL’si kullanın. Discord destekliyorsa animasyonlu GIF’ler animasyonlu kalır. Bir Tenor/Giphy sayfa bağlantısı (doğrudan dosya değil) burada önizlenmez, ancak mesaj gönderildiğinde doğru şekilde çözümlenir.

help.permissions: Wody’nin burada ihtiyaç duyduğu tüm izinleri yok, bu yüzden modülün bu kısmı çalışamadı.
help.channel: Bunun için seçilen kanal artık yok ya da Wody onu artık göremiyor. Modülü açıp yeniden bir kanal seç.
help.role_missing: Bunun için seçilen rol silindi. Modülü açıp yeniden bir rol seç.
help.role_order: Discord, Wody’nin yalnızca kendi en yüksek rolünün altındaki rolleri vermesine veya değiştirmesine izin verir.
help.role_managed: Bu rol bir entegrasyona veya bota ait (ya da @everyone), bu yüzden hiçbir bot veremez. Modülde normal bir rol seç.
help.refused: Discord bu işlemi reddetti. Neredeyse her zaman eksik bir izin ya da rol sırası sorunudur; aşağıdaki ayrıntılar Discord’un yanıtını gösterir.
help.card: Bu kartın görseli yüklenemedi, genellikle bağlantısı artık çalışmadığı için. Modülde başka bir görsel yükle veya seç; o zamana kadar Wody mesajı görselsiz gönderir.
help.feed_source: Kaynak artık yok ya da adı veya bağlantısı değişti. Pulse’ta kontrol et ve doğru ad veya bağlantıyla yeniden ekle.
help.feed_passing: Kaynak art arda birkaç kez düzgün yanıt vermedi. Sorun kaynaktadır ve genellikle kendiliğinden geçer: Wody otomatik olarak denemeye devam eder ve sunucunda bir şey değiştirmen gerekmez. Bir günden uzun sürerse kaynağın hâlâ çalışıp çalışmadığını kontrol et.
help.feed_input: Bu kaynağın adı veya bağlantısı kullanılamıyor. Pulse’u aç, akışı kaldır ve herkese açık bir ad veya bağlantıyla yeniden ekle.
help.module_disabled: Bu modül kurulu ama kapalı, bu yüzden hiçbir şey yapmıyor. Başlatmak için paneldeki anahtarını aç.
help.internal: Bu işlem sırasında Wody’de bir şeyler ters gitti. Sunucunda hiçbir şey değişmedi. Tekrar olursa Wody destek ekibine ulaş.
help.owner_nick: Discord hiçbir botun sunucu sahibinin adını değiştirmesine izin vermez. Düzeltilecek bir şey yok; bu ödül sahibi atlar.
help.generic: Wody bu işlemi tamamlayamadı. Aşağıdaki ayrıntılar ne olduğunu anlatıyor.

errorLog.fixPermissionsChannel: Nasıl düzeltilir: Discord’da {channel} ayarlarını aç, İzinler’e git, Wody’yi (veya rolünü) seç ve yukarıdaki izinlere izin ver. Orada hiçbirinin reddedilmediğinden emin ol.
